options.text: Do you need any help in the vineyards?

steps.player: Do you need any help in the vineyards?

steps.text: If the player doesn't have a grape barrel:

steps.npc: Well we could always use a spare pair of hands!

steps.text: The foreman gives you a grape barrel.

steps.npc: Here, fill this barrel with four sets of ripe grapes and bring it back to me.

steps.text: If the player has worked at Luthas' banana plantation in Karamja before:

steps.player: Ah, this sounds like something I can do! I actually used to have a similar job on another island far to the east of here!
Got it! One barrel full of grapes coming right up.

steps.npc: Just remember, I need them to be ripe. Generally, perfectly ripe grapes are full and vibrant. They'll shine in the sunlight more than others.

steps.text: If the player doesn't have a grape barrel but has received one before:
The foreman gives you a grape barrel.

steps.npc: Hopefully you know what you're doing now. Just fill this barrel with four sets of ripe grapes and bring it back to me.

steps.player: Got it! One barrel full of grapes coming right up.

steps.npc: Just remember, I need them to be ripe. Generally, perfectly ripe grapes are full and vibrant. They'll shine in the sunlight more than others.

steps.text: If the player doesn't have a grape barrel and doesn't have inventory space:

steps.npc: We could always use a spare pair of hands! I have a grape barrel here for you, but you don't have enough room for it at the moment. Come back once you can carry it.

steps.text: If the player already has a grape barrel:

steps.npc: You've already got that grape barrel I gave you. Fill it with four sets of ripe grapes and bring it back to me.

steps.player: Got it! One barrel full of grapes coming right up.

steps.npc: Just remember, I need them to be ripe. Generally, perfectly ripe grapes are full and vibrant. They'll shine in the sunlight more than others.

options.text: Doesn't it get hot standing out here all day?

steps.player: Doesn't it get hot standing out here all day?

steps.npc: Ah, you get used to it. Besides, I have a near-infinite supply of lukewarm grape juice to keep me hydrated!

options.text: I'm good. I'll be going now.

steps.player: I'm good. I'll be going now.

standard-dialogue-talking-with-a-full-gr.player: One barrel o' grapes here for you, boss!

standard-dialogue-talking-with-a-full-gr.npc: Great work! Here, keep some grapes as payment.

standard-dialogue-talking-with-a-full-gr.player: Can I have some gold instead?

standard-dialogue-talking-with-a-full-gr.npc: Now, if you're up for it, I wouldn't say no to you filling the barrel up again.
